## Recommended article structure

**Slug:** `/ai-for-small-business-marketing/`
**H1:** AI for Small Business Marketing: A Practical Guide for 2026
**Meta description:** Discover how small businesses use AI to automate marketing, generate leads, and grow without hiring. Real tools, real ROI, no hype.
**Word count target:** 1,800–2,400 (the sweet spot for KD 8 — long enough to rank, short enough to actually publish)

### Outline

1. **Hook** — *"You don't need an engineer to use AI in your marketing. You need 90 minutes and a credit card."* (TSAI brand voice: warm, practical, plain-language)
2. **The reality** — what AI actually does for a small business marketing operation today (email, content, ads, social, customer outreach)
3. **The 5 highest-ROI AI marketing plays for a small business** (each with a tool example + estimated time-saved)
   - Email triage & drafting (saves ~5 hrs/week)
   - Social media content generation
   - Ad copy + variant testing
   - SEO content (this very article is the example)
   - Customer support automation
4. **The "best AI tool for small businesses" comparison table** (answers PAA #2; this is the section that captures the 210/mo searches)
5. **PAA section** — answer all 10 questions as H3 sub-blocks (or a structured FAQ at the bottom — both work; FAQ blocks are easier for Google to surface)
6. **The honest part — why 85% of AI projects fail and how small businesses avoid it** (answers PAA #3; also a credibility play)
7. **What's next for your business** — soft CTA to the free AI Power Scale Assessment + the AI Chief of Staff app
8. **FAQ block** — the 10 PAA questions in `<FAQPage>` schema for rich-result eligibility

## On-page SEO checklist

- [ ] Target keyword in H1, first 100 words, one H2, meta description, slug, image alt
- [ ] Parent topic ("AI for small business") used 3–5x naturally throughout

- [ ] At least 5 internal links to existing TSAI pages

- [ ] FAQ schema implementing the 10 PAA answers
- [ ] Author bio block at end (E-E-A-T signal — Brett's credentials)
- [ ] Reading time estimate at top
